I have a few questions about what to expect next and would appreciate your assessment of the strengths and weaknesses of my position in light of this new filing. Additionally, I wanted to let you know that I have witnesses regarding the breach of contract, though I haven't formally lined them up yet.

Could we schedule a brief call or meeting to discuss these points and our strategy for the response?

Best regards,
Vince
